name: app-lavender-project-introduction-with-metadata-and-jumping-travellers-photo
title: Project Introduction with Jumping Travellers
whatItIs: A lavender slide titled Project Introduction with a plane progress bar, a large paragraph, a metadata row (project, year, industry, topic pills) and a wide rounded photo of five backpackers jumping by the sea with an overlaid caption.
whatItMeans: An energetic photo makes an introduction feel joyful, and the metadata row keeps the facts tidy.
techniques: Four-column metadata row with hairline dividers
Large rounded photo with white caption overlay
Blue gradient in the second title word

vocabulary.definition: A row of labelled facts divided by hairlines.
A rounded tag naming a subject.
Text placed over the lower edge of a photo.
